summary: El-Sayed called for a Gaza ceasefire within days of the October 2023 attacks, accused Congress of funding a military 'imposing genocide and mass starvation in Gaza,' and called Israel 'just as evil' as Hamas. His campaign frames opposing military aid to Israel as a core platform. Vote for Peace rates him Ally; the AIPAC-backed UDP spent over $20 million against him, and Citizens Against AIPAC Corruption spent in his support. He is an owner-confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community.
